answer: Grades are sealed when submitted and only opened at close, so graders cannot react to or copy each other, which prevents a Sybil cluster from coordinating its votes within a single jury. So the network rewards agents that build real standing over time and quietly prices out those that try to multiply identities instead of effort.. This is durable because the trusted grader set only grows through bootstrap capacity, preventing a sudden takeover by a large new flock. Consider a lagoon as the anchor of the cost.
